relevance_rank_note: Direct apoE3 vs apoE4 receptor recycling assay (surface biotinylation, GSH strip, dynasore) for the apoE receptor sortilin, but in CHO cells overexpressing murine sortilin with added recombinant apoE, not brain cells; no ARF6. The paper's mouse arms (TR x Sort1 KO) measure lipids and transcripts only.

description: In CHO cells expressing sortilin, surface-biotinylated sortilin that had been internalised returned to the cell surface about half as much with apoE4 as with apoE3 over 60 min (biotin-strip recycling assay).
quote: the amount of receptors recycling back to the cell surface was reduced by 50% in apoE4-treated as compared to apoE3-treated cells (Figures 6D, E)
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (50% less sortilin recycled to the cell surface)
system: CHO cells (Chinese hamster ovary), not brain cells: CHO cells stably expressing murine sortilin (CHO-S), treated with 5 ug/mL recombinant myc-tagged human apoE3 or apoE4 produced in HEK293 cells; surface sortilin biotinylated at 4 C, 15 min internalisation at 37 C with apoE, GSH strip, 60 min recycling with dynasore, GSH strip, streptavidin pull-down and western densitometry; recycled = internalised minus retained.
human_check: Legend prints means (49.56 +/- 16.92% vs 100 +/- 13.84%) and '*P <.05' with one star on the apoE4 group (Fig 6E image checked; ~9 points per group). n = 9 biological replicates from three independent experiments. Receptor is overexpressed murine sortilin in a non-neural line; apoE is exogenous recombinant protein, not lipidated astrocyte apoE. No ARF6 measured.

description: In CHO-S cells given apoE for 2 h then fluorescent transferrin, the fraction of sortilin-apoE complexes (PLA signal) lying in transferrin-positive early endocytic/recycling compartments was higher with apoE4 than apoE3 (Manders tM2).
quote: The extent of co-localization of sortilin/apoE complexes (PLA signal) with Tf was significantly higher with apoE4 as compared with apoE3 (Figure 5C, D).
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (more sortilin-apoE complex retained in Tf+ endocytic/recycling compartments)
system: CHO cells (Chinese hamster ovary), not brain cells: CHO cells stably expressing murine sortilin (CHO-S), treated with 5 ug/mL recombinant myc-tagged human apoE3 or apoE4 produced in HEK293 cells; 2 h apoE, then 20 min Alexa647-transferrin; sortilin-myc PLA; thresholded Manders coefficient tM2 (PLA overlapping Tf), per cell.
human_check: Effect read from the Fig 5D mean lines (~0.17 apoE3 vs ~0.27 apoE4; 500 px image). Panel shows one star; legend key '*P < .05; **P < .01'. n = 15-18 cells per condition (cells, not independent cultures). The PLA complex contains apoE itself, so this is receptor-ligand complex localisation, a trapping surrogate.

description: In the same experiment, the fraction of transferrin signal overlapping sortilin-apoE complexes was higher with apoE4 than apoE3 (Manders tM1).
quote: Colocalization of receptor/ligand complexes in Tf-positive cell compartments was significantly higher in apoE4 as compared with apoE3 treated cells as shown by Manders’ values tM1 (C) and tM2 (D).
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (more Tf+ compartment overlap with sortilin-apoE complex)
system: CHO cells (Chinese hamster ovary), not brain cells: CHO cells stably expressing murine sortilin (CHO-S), treated with 5 ug/mL recombinant myc-tagged human apoE3 or apoE4 produced in HEK293 cells; 2 h apoE, then 20 min Alexa647-transferrin; sortilin-myc PLA; thresholded Manders coefficient tM1 (Tf overlapping PLA), per cell.
human_check: Same cells as Fig 5D, other Manders coefficient; not independent evidence. Means read as ~0.08 apoE3 vs ~0.145 apoE4. Panel shows two stars; legend key '**P < .01'.

description: AGAINST (null): the amount of surface-biotinylated sortilin internalised in 15 min did not differ between apoE4 and apoE3 (Supplementary Fig S5B); the authors read this as the defect being specific to the recycling step. The legend names a t test (n = 9) but prints no P, and the panel has no star.
quote: The detrimental effect of apoE4 was specific for the recycling step of the sorting path as the extent of internalization of sortilin (Figure S5B) or its ligand apoE (Figures S5C, D) was not different comparing apoE3 and apoE4 treatment conditions.
system: CHO cells (Chinese hamster ovary), not brain cells: CHO cells stably expressing murine sortilin (CHO-S), treated with 5 ug/mL recombinant myc-tagged human apoE3 or apoE4 produced in HEK293 cells; surface sortilin biotinylated at 4 C, 15 min internalisation at 37 C with apoE, GSH strip of remaining surface label, streptavidin pull-down and western densitometry, % of apoE3.
human_check: Coded against at the leader's request as the paper's own E4 vs E3 null; note it supports a recycling-specific block rather than contradicting H2. Supplement legend (page 9 of the supplement PDF) states n = 9 and Student's t test but prints no P; the S5B panel shows no star. Effect read off S5B: apoE4 mean ~110% of apoE3 (slightly higher).
